shortDescription: TORONTO, Oct. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Matachewan Consolidated Mines, Limited TSXV:MCMA (“Matachewan”) and McChip Resources Inc. TSXV:MCS (“McChip” and, together with Matachewan, the “Acquirors”) announce that, on October 19, 2026, they acquired an aggregate of 42,675,809 common shares (the “Co…

children: ”) announce that, on October 19, 2026, they acquired an aggregate of 42,675,809 common shares (the “
”) in connection with the closing of the first tranche (the “
”) of the Company’s non-brokered private placement (the “

”). The Company’s head office is located at the Canadian Venture Building, 82 Richmond Street East, Toronto, Ontario M5C 1P1. The address of each of Matachewan and McChip is 1 Adelaide Street East, Suite 801, Toronto, Ontario M5C 2V9.

The First Tranche consisted of the issuance by the Company of 42,675,809 Common Shares on a “flow-through” basis at a price of $0.05 per Common Share, for aggregate gross proceeds of $2,133,790.45. Matachewan acquired ownership of 21,337,905 Common Shares for total consideration of $1,066,895.25, and McChip acquired ownership of 21,337,904 Common Shares for total consideration of $1,066,895.20, in each case at a price of $0.05 per Common Share pursuant to a subscription agreement with the Company. The Common Shares were issued from treasury by way of private placement, and the acquisitions did not take place on any marketplace.

Immediately prior to closing of the First Tranche, neither Matachewan nor McChip owned or controlled any Common Shares. Immediately following closing of the First Tranche, Matachewan owns and controls 21,337,905 Common Shares and McChip owns and controls 21,337,904 Common Shares, each representing approximately 9.995% of the issued and outstanding Common Shares on a non-diluted basis, an increase of approximately 9.995% for each Acquiror. The Acquirors are joint actors and together own and control 42,675,809 Common Shares, representing approximately 19.99% of the issued and outstanding Common Shares on a non-diluted basis.

The Acquirors hold their Common Shares as part of a strategic investment in the Company. In connection with the First Tranche, Raymond D. Harari was appointed as a director of the Company and is anticipated to be appointed President at a later date. The Acquirors are entitled to, and intend to, subscribe for additional Common Shares on a non-flow-through basis in the second tranche of the Offering, pursuant to their subscription agreements with the Company and the investor rights agreement among the Company and the Acquirors dated October 19, 2026 (the "

"), such that they collectively hold approximately 19.99% of the issued and outstanding Common Shares following its completion, subject to the cap in the Investor Rights Agreement, TSXV acceptance and applicable law.

Each Acquiror intends to review its holdings in the Company on a continuing basis and may purchase or sell Common Shares in the future, including in private transactions (and, if applicable, through a marketplace), in each case depending on a number of factors. The Acquirors may formulate other purposes, plans or proposals regarding the Company or any of its securities or may change their intentions with respect to any and all matters. The Acquirors, in consultation with the Company, may also propose or seek to effect certain corporate transactions involving the Company.
The acquisition of the Common Shares did not constitute a formal bid, and the Acquirors did not rely on any exemption from the formal bid requirements in connection with the acquisition.

Each of Matachewan and McChip will file an early warning report in accordance with applicable securities laws, which will be available under the Company’s profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca. A copy of each early warning report may also be obtained by contacting Zachary Goldenberg, Chief Executive Officer of Matachewan and McChip, at 647-987-5083.

Matachewan is a Canadian natural resource company incorporated in 1933 and headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. Matachewan maintains exposure to the natural resource sector through investments in mineral and other resource-related opportunities. Its common shares trade on the TSXV under the symbol MCMA.

McChip is a Canadian natural resource company incorporated in 1935 and headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. McChip maintains exposure to the natural resource sector through investments in mineral and other resource-related opportunities. Its common shares trade on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol MCS.
